Affordable Re-Rental Units
Stella Heights HDFC

Stella Heights HDFC Located in Washington Heights

Single room occupancy units.

Development located in the heart of Washington Heights, one of Upper Manhattan's most vibrant and culturally rich neighborhoods. If you prefer to mail/drop off an application and documents, please download the application and mail/drop off the completed application and documents to:

Stella Heights HDFC c/o MHANY Lottery Dept.

470 Vanderbilt Avenue 9th FL

Brooklyn NY 11238

DOWNLOAD APPLICATION
REQUIRED DOCUMENTS LIST

You also have the option to send application and documents via email:

stellaheights@mutualhousingny.org


**Note 1 application per person**


**Income requirements $0.00 - $59,400.00**


**Household size- 1 person**

Highlights of Washington Heights

575 West 155th Street

Button
Button
Button
Button
Button
Button
Button
Button

Excellent Transportation

  • Just a short walk to the 1 train (157 St) and C train (155 St), with nearby access to the A, B, and D trains, making commuting throughout Manhattan and the Bronx easy. (StreetEasy)
  • Numerous MTA bus routes serve Broadway, Amsterdam Avenue, and St. Nicholas Avenue.﻿

Dining & Shopping

  • Located near Broadway's lively commercial corridor with:
  • Dominican, Mexican, and Latin American restaurants
  • Pizza shops, cafés, bakeries, and grocery stores
  • Local supermarkets and neighborhood businesses
  • Washington Heights is known throughout NYC for its authentic Dominican cuisine and diverse international dining. (Homes.com)

Parks & Recreation

  • Minutes from Fort Washington Park, featuring:
  • Hudson River walking and biking paths
  • Sports fields
  • Scenic waterfront views
  • Close to Highbridge Park and the historic High Bridge.
  • Near the legendary Holcombe Rucker Park, one of the world's most famous outdoor basketball courts.﻿

Arts & Culture

  • Walking distance to the Hispanic Society Museum & Library.
  • Close to the American Academy of Arts and Letters.
  • Features the colorful Audubon Mural Project throughout the neighborhood.﻿

530 West 178th Street

Button
Button

Button

Outstanding Transportation

  • Convenient access to the A train at 175 St, 1 train at 181 St, and several local bus routes.
  • Just minutes from the George Washington Bridge Bus Terminal
  • , providing convenient service throughout Manhattan and to New Jersey. (NYC Government)

Dining & Everyday Conveniences

  • Surrounded by neighborhood restaurants, cafés, bakeries, pharmacies, grocery stores, and essential retail.
  • Broadway and St. Nicholas Avenue offer a wide variety of affordable dining options.﻿

Beautiful Green Spaces

  • Close to Fort Tryon Park, one of Manhattan's most beautiful parks, known for:
  • Gardens
  • Walking trails
  • Spectacular Hudson River views
  • Easy access to Fort Washington Park and the Hudson River Greenway.
  • Near scenic overlooks of the George Washington Bridge and the Hudson River. (Douglas Elliman)

Culture & Recreation

  • Minutes from The Met Cloisters, home to world-renowned medieval art and architecture.
  • Near the pedestrian walkway of the George Washington Bridge for walking and cycling.
  • Close to the recently renovated Fort Washington Library.﻿
